metadata.scope: Official public HRM CAO contract-amendment reports identified from May 2023 through November 2025.
metadata.principle: These are public CAO contract-amendment reporting records, not invoices, AP transactions, final paid values or findings of wrongdoing. Public reports may exclude Private & Confidential amendment records.
